      "name": "build",

      "evidence": "Touches CMakeLists.txt (+1/-0) and updates Windows target compatibility solely to enable socket queries for compact block prefilling.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "platform fix",
      "rationale": "The single-line CMake change is incidental to socket querying requirements and does not address build system mechanics or release integrity."
    },
    {
      "name": "p2p",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Carries the P2P label and modifies block relay in src/net_processing.cpp, src/net.cpp, and src/blockencodings.cpp.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.7,
      "reason_tag": "speedup",
      "rationale": "Predictive prefilling bounded by TCP window size dramatically cuts block propagation delays across the network. Live telemetry showed that TCP-window-bounded prefilling raised immediate compact block reconstruction from 56.9% to 89.7% without a getblocktxn round-trip, avoiding propagation delays that contribute to stale blocks."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Modifies test harnesses and benchmarks (src/test/sock_tests.cpp, src/bench/blockencodings.cpp, fuzz targets) to adapt to prefill changes.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "Test and fuzz changes follow directly from the p2p block relay alterations rather than touching test framework machinery."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Adds cross-platform socket inspection methods in src/util/sock.h and src/util/sock.cpp.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Extends the Sock utility class to query TCP window and queue sizes across Linux, macOS, the BSDs, and Windows. This provides worthwhile new socket-inspection capabilities, though its immediate application is specialized to P2P block transport."
    }
